R01.reason: category colours are authored in Theme.qml and applied by the painter

R02.reason: scope navigation and hierarchy commands are panel state plus the shared command path

R03.reason: port position, hit region and card core guard are geometry facts

R04.reason: port position and hit region are geometry facts

R05.reason: the card rectangle the visuals fill is geometry

R06.reason: the pulled route is a geometry polyline consumed by the connect session and the painter

R07.reason: route polyline and point-to-segment projection are geometry; the reroute session consumes them

R08.reason: the wire path the painter walks is the geometry polyline

R09.reason: wire geometry is owned once and consumed by both picking and drawing

R10.reason: node move is a gesture session; it commits one move command through the facade

R11.reason: drag and marquee selection are gesture sessions over the hit-test result

R12.reason: snapping adjusts the session's candidate positions against geometry

R13.reason: creation commits one command through the facade and reads the scene for its anchor

R14.reason: deletion commits one command through the facade; the scene records what was removed

R15.reason: click arbitration and double-click dispatch are panel input plumbing

R16.reason: the panel owns the input path and hands the gesture sessions their events

R17.reason: the search field is panel chrome; it drives placement through the same command path

R18.reason: the tools/category hotbar is panel chrome

R19.reason: category tokens are panel-side settings consumed by placement

R20.reason: inspector popup arrangement is panel state
